ops.text: Nor need they transfer across context lengths, because retention is defined relative to the prefill length: if the budget that preserves utility grows with length as reported for SuBA (Mowat et al., 2026), the 0.35 retention certified for Layer-DefensiveKV on RULER-32K would correspond to only about 0.20 at 128K, roughly 27K retained tokens, so a certificate obtained at one length would have to be recalibrated at another.
